text:
omar: Opening a short thread: we need to cover partial-apply semantics for large onprem packages. customers install parts of a model bundle in stages; what's the canonical state machine?
lucy: I keep hitting ambiguity: does 'applied' mean all components passed postinstall checks, or that a threshold of components are active?
jin: I'd like a model where 'apply' has explicit phases: staged->activated->committed. staged = files present; activated = voters report activation; committed = control-plane marks global complete.
omar: That aligns with previous convo but we need concrete transitions when some components fail postinstall. Do we allow 'partial-commit' with pinned fallback?
tara: From ops: partial-commit is useful. Example: model shards can be lazy-loaded; if noncritical shards fail, we can still commit core shards and schedule retry for optional shards. mark optional via manifest flags.
lucy: So manifest needs per-component attributes: {id, required: bool, activation_order: [seq], optional_retry_policy}.
jin: Also need atomicity group tags. Some components must commit together or not at all. Group semantics: all-or-nothing within group.
ara: (typo: tara)
tara: ops-bot: deploy-bot telemetry shows ~6% of large bundle installs have noncritical failures that can be retried without user-visible degradation. default behavior should be: commit core groups automatically, leave optional groups in 'deferred' with backoff.
omar: Good. For rollback: if a required component fails post-commit, we should not auto-rollback for onprem customers; instead surface 'committed-degraded' and give a reconcile button. auto-rollback should be opt-in.
jin: Security: every activation/commit event must have signed receipts from the node agent and be recorded in the audit log. receipt schema: {voter, component_id, phase: activated|committed, ts, nonce, sig}.
tara: UX: console timeline should expose component groups, their states, and a bulk action to 'retry deferred' with optional per-component reason. For compliance customers, require audit reason on commit when any deferred components exist.
lucy: Testplan: scenarios for network partitions, node death mid-activation, and mismatched manifest where operator removed a voter mid-flow. Include a conflict resolution flow: 'merge receipts' or 'abort commit'.
omar: API: introduce /packages/{id}/actions with actions: finalize_commit, abort_commit, force_rollback, retry_component. finalize_commit requires reason if deferred_count>0.
jin: Metrics: gauge(component_states{required,optional}), counter(partial_commits), histogram(commit_latency).	op s-bot: note: recommend default retry_policy = exponential backoff with 3 attempts and jitter; default commit_delay_seconds = 600 to allow late activations.
tara: I'll coordinate runbook updates. ops-bot: include recommended alerts: high deferred_count, stuck_in_staged>10m.
omar: Next step: I'll fold this into an RFC draft focusing on manifest schema, state machine diagram, and API surface. reviewers: lucy, jin, tara.
lucy: I'll add test scenarios.
jin: I'll add receipt validation and KMS rotation notes.
tara: I'll add support playbook steps.
omar: Thanks all. I'll post the RFC link when ready. :wave:
